-        special_pattern = "(" + "|".join(re.escape(k) for k in special) + ")"

--- a/minbpe/regex.py
+++ b/minbpe/regex.py
@@ -35,1 +35,30 @@
-# the main GPT text split patterns, see
+def _split_special(text, keys):
+    """
+    Same as re.split("(" + "|".join(map(re.escape, keys)) + ")", text) for
+    non-empty str keys: the leftmost occurrence of any key matches, and at
+    equal positions the first key in order wins (alternation order).
+    """
+    find = text.find
+    nxt = [find(k) for k in keys]
+    parts = []
+    app = parts.append
+    pos = 0
+    while True:
+        best = -1
+        bk = None
+        for k, j in zip(keys, nxt):
+            if j >= 0 and (best < 0 or j < best):
+                best = j
+                bk = k
+        if bk is None:
+            break
+        app(text[pos:best])
+        app(bk)
+        pos = best + len(bk)
+        nxt = [j if j < 0 or j >= pos else find(k, pos)
+               for k, j in zip(keys, nxt)]
+    app(text[pos:])
+    return parts
+
